About Krishiv

At KRISHIV Labels & Packaging, we believe packaging is more than protection — it is a powerful brand experience. It is often the first physical interaction a customer has with a product, shaping perceptions of quality, value, and trust. We create thoughtfully designed and precisely manufactured labels and packaging solutions that help products stand out, strengthen brand identity, and create memorable experiences.

With a strong focus on quality, precision, innovation, and consistency, KRISHIV offers a comprehensive range of packaging solutions including self-adhesive labels, mono cartons, paper tube packaging, header cards, blister packs, tags, sleeves, inserts, and leaflets. From everyday packaging requirements to premium, high-impact applications, every solution is developed with careful attention to aesthetics, functionality, durability, and production efficiency.

Our capabilities serve a diverse range of industries, including Food & Beverage, Bakery & Chocolates, Personal Care & Cosmetics, Healthcare & Pharmaceuticals, Retail & Lifestyle, Toys & Kids Products, Steel & Homeware, Plastic Homeware & Stationery, and Industrial Products. Our experience across these sectors enables us to understand the specific requirements of different products and deliver packaging solutions tailored to each application.

At KRISHIV, we bring together modern printing technologies, quality materials, skilled craftsmanship, and meticulous quality control. Our integrated approach covers the packaging journey from concept and artwork to structural development, printing, finishing, and final production, helping our customers achieve consistency, reliability, and efficiency at every stage.

We see every label, carton, tag, or package as an opportunity to communicate a brand's story and reinforce its value. Through thoughtful design, precise production, and quality finishing, we help brands create stronger shelf presence, build consumer confidence, and make their products more memorable.

Driven by customer focus, continuous improvement, and uncompromising quality, KRISHIV Labels & Packaging strives to be a dependable long-term packaging partner for businesses looking to elevate their products and build stronger brands.
